background.value: white (uniform, no ink marks, no borders, no artificial removal or compositing)

head_height.value: 3.2-3.6cm (from crown of head, excluding hair, to chin)

file_spec.value: JPG/JPEG, max 500KB, recommended 413x531 pixels (acceptable range: 395-431 x 507-550 pixels), 300 DPI recommended

clothing_restriction.value: neck covering acceptable if face outline exposed; no scarves covering facial contours

expression_restriction.value: natural neutral expression, closed mouth, no teeth showing, eyes open looking straight ahead

glasses_policy.value: regular glasses permitted if frames do not obscure eyes and no glare; no sunglasses, tinted, colored, cosmetic, or blue-light lenses

ears_visibility.value: ears must be visible; hair must not cover ears (exception: naturally non-visible ears from front)

face_visibility.value: hair cannot cover eyes, eyebrows, or facial contours (cheekbones, jawline); forehead to chin must be fully visible

headwear_policy.value: no hats, headbands, or hair accessories; religious headwear permitted if worn daily and full face visible (forehead to chin)

accessories.value: no jewelry causing light reflection or obscuring face; no earphones or wireless earbuds

size.evidence: Official passport.go.kr (외교부 여권안내) confirms 3.5cm x 4.5cm. Head length 3.2-3.6cm (crown to chin). Compliant with ICAO standards. Fetched directly from https://www.passport.go.kr/home/kor/contents.do?menuPos=32
